name: Chickpea & spinach curry
method: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger. Add spices, then chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer 15 minutes. Stir the spinach through at the end.

name: Lemon herb roast chicken thighs
method: Toss everything in a tray. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes until the skin crackles.

name: Pad thai with tofu
method: Soak noodles. Fry tofu, push aside, scramble the eggs. Add noodles and sauce, toss hard. Peanuts and lime on top.

name: Minestrone
method: Sweat the vegetables, add tomatoes and stock, simmer 20 minutes. Pasta and beans in for the last 10.

name: Shakshuka
method: Cook down the peppers and tomatoes with the spices. Make four wells, crack in the eggs, lid on until just set.

name: Dal tadka with rice
method: Boil the dal with turmeric until soft. Make the tadka in ghee and pour it over. Serve with rice.

name: Miso salmon with greens
method: Glaze the salmon with the miso mix, grill 10 minutes. Steam the greens. Sesame on top.

name: Black bean tacos
method: Warm the beans with the spices and mash lightly. Char the tortillas. Build with avocado, onion and lime.

name: Mushroom risotto
method: Toast the rice, deglaze with wine, add stock a ladle at a time for 20 minutes. Beat in butter and parmesan off the heat.

name: Greek salad with grilled halloumi
method: Grill the halloumi until it squeaks. Everything else raw, dressed, on a plate.

name: Sesame soba noodle salad
method: Cook and cool the noodles. Whisk the dressing until it loosens. Toss everything together cold.

name: Roast cauliflower & lentil bowl
method: Roast the cauliflower hard at 220C. Simmer lentils. Combine warm with lemon and rocket.

name: Prawn & garlic linguine
method: Pasta on. Garlic and chilli in oil, prawns in for two minutes, wine to deglaze. Toss with the pasta and its water.

name: Sweet potato & peanut stew
method: Build the base, add sweet potato and stock, simmer 25 minutes. Stir in peanut butter and kale.

name: Egg fried rice
method: Very hot wok. Eggs first, out. Rice until it crackles. Everything back in, sauce last.

name: Tomato & white bean braise
method: Soften the onion and garlic, add everything else, simmer 20 minutes until it thickens.

name: Chicken pho
method: Infuse the stock with the aromatics for 30 minutes. Poach the chicken, slice it. Assemble in the bowl, broth over the top.

name: Aubergine parmigiana
method: Griddle the aubergine slices. Layer with sauce and cheese. Bake 35 minutes at 190C.

name: Quinoa tabbouleh
method: Cook and cool the quinoa. Chop the herbs far more finely than feels reasonable. Dress heavily.

name: Congee with ginger & scallion
method: Simmer rice in stock with the ginger for 45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it collapses into porridge.

name: Lamb kofta with flatbread
method: Mix, shape onto skewers, grill 8 minutes turning. Yogurt, cucumber and garlic make the sauce.

name: Rice-noodle veggie stir fry
method: Hot pan, hard vegetables first, soft ones after. Noodles and sauce in for the last minute.
